mapper.select: SELECT GROUP_ID, OWNER_ID, VISIBILITY, JOIN_CODE_VERSION, JOIN_CODE_KEY_VER, JOIN_CODE_ISSUED_AT FROM GYE_GROUP WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE GYE_GROUP SET JOIN_CODE_ENC = #{encryptedCode}, JOIN_CODE_KEY_VER = #{keyVersion}, JOIN_CODE_VERSION = JOIN_CODE_VERSION + 1, JOIN_CODE_ISSUED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND OWNER_ID = #{ownerId} AND VISIBILITY = 'PRIVATE'
